purpose: Primary visible weapons and safe audit poses for the ten Bounty Hunter arena characters.
action_row_source: Runtime descriptor byte +0x05 in the 24-byte table at ARM9 0x020EF57C; copied to actor +0x6c3 by 0x02006288..0x020062A0.

4lom.label: 4-LOM
4lom.evidence: ROM, not the MiniKit. Action row 31 at 0x020F7004 holds weapon id 487 at +0x00; 0x020EB7BC + 8*487 gives model asset 4706 StTrprBlstr - the same weapon IG-88 and Leia carry. This entry previously read 618 BobaRifle because LOMMiniKit asset 2 names BobaRifle, which is what the collectable statue is built from and not what the character carries in play. See config/weapon_models.json and tools/export_weapon_models.py.

boba_fett.label: Boba Fett
boba_fett.evidence: BobaFettMiniKit 568 and BobaFettStatue 614 name BobaRifle; standalone model is asset 618.

bossk.label: Bossk
bossk.evidence: Bossk gameplay cluster contains BosskRifle 672 and BosskGrenade 625; rifle is the idle primary.

dengar.label: Dengar
dengar.evidence: DengarMiniKit 1756 and DengarStatue 1791 name the BobaRifle family. Runtime metadata byte 0 is 4 for both Boba Fett row 7 and Dengar row 13; Dengar has no separate idle-gun animation.

greedo.label: Greedo
greedo.evidence: Playable Greedo proof case; standalone grey Pistol asset 3865 and recovered Human_Model RWeapon transform.

ig88.label: IG-88
ig88.evidence: IG88MiniKit 2887 and IG88Statue 2928 name StTrprBlstr; standalone model is asset 4706.

jango_fett.label: Jango Fett
jango_fett.evidence: JangoFettMiniKit 3026 contains PistolBlaster and PistolBlaster1; standalone matching grey pistol is asset 3865.

princess_leia_boushh.label: Princess Leia (Boushh)
princess_leia_boushh.evidence: Runtime row 36 selects LeiaBountyHelmet 3474 with Boushh legs 3478 and torso 3480. BousshMiniKit 693 names StTrprBlstr. Animation 493 is the generic rifle-idle candidate pending direct gameplay capture comparison.

lando_calrissian_jabbas_palace.label: Lando Calrissian (Jabba's Palace)
lando_calrissian_jabbas_palace.evidence: Runtime row 34 selects LandoBountyHelmet 3364 with Palace Lando legs 3368 and torso 3370. PLandoMiniKit 3870 includes LandosAxe; standalone model is asset 3377. Animation 491 is a safe neutral weapon-idle candidate pending direct gameplay capture comparison.

zuckuss.label: Zuckuss
zuckuss.evidence: Dedicated ZuckussRifle gameplay model 5538. Animation 491 is a safe fallback: ZuckussIdleGun 5529 currently reproduces the known collapsed-limb conversion regression.
